prompt: rgb.jpg is a horizontal strip of 5 frames, left to right in time order, sampled from the few seconds of a head-mounted (egocentric) video; the camera wearer is the viewpoint. Describe the spatial understanding this image supports: the layout of the scene; which people and objects are present and roughly how far each is from the camera wearer (in metres) and from each other; relative positions (left/right/in front/behind, above/below); which way people face and whether they look toward the camera wearer; what is within arm's reach of the camera wearer or of others; occlusions and anything partly out of view; and how these change across the 5 frames (approach, retreat, turning). Describe only spatial facts. Do not guess anyone's intentions, social norms, or what anyone should do. Return only JSON: {"rgb": "..."} with 4-6 sentences.

descriptions.rgb: The scene is a narrow indoor passage or room with a wooden floor, walls and doorways along the right, and chairs, boxes, or other furniture clustered mostly along the left and far end. In the first two frames, the camera points downward and turns right while moving forward; nearby furniture is roughly 0.5–1.5 m away, with some objects cut off by the frame edges. In frames three through five, one person is about 0.5–1.5 m in front of the camera wearer, slightly right of center, facing mostly away and not visibly looking toward the camera; no other person is clearly visible. The person and a green-and-red carried object are within roughly an arm's length of each other, while the camera wearer's extended arm and translucent plastic containers occupy the foreground within about 0.2–0.6 m and partly occlude the person. Across the sequence, the camera wearer approaches and passes close behind or beside the person, then raises or extends the containers toward the upper-left foreground as the person shifts farther ahead and becomes increasingly cropped and occluded.
